searchText: In the `Request Blob Pooled Transactions` test, it looks like the expected length is the length _without_ the rlp header, I thought it would be defined as the length of the network encoding If this is supposed to be correct then there definitely needs to be more specification in eth/68 > sizes (as defined in EIP-2718) because this doesn't really specify whether it should be `len(type || tx body)` or `len(rlp string header || type || tx body)` it should be the length of the 'consensus encoding' of transactions (i.e. the bytes without rlp header)
